description:
"Summon an expanding beam of pure sunlight to doom an enemy, dealing |cffffff4038|r Magic Damage immediately and marking them for |cffffff6|r seconds.

After the duration ends, the sunlight bursts, dealing |cffffff4469|r Magic Damage, which increases based on the amount of damage you dealt to them over the duration, up to |cffffff200|r%. Also heals you and nearby allies in the area for |cffffff1886|r Health every |cffffff2|r seconds, over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You can have only one Purifying Light at a time."
